children: Gram (prev. Toncoin) has a token unlock scheduled for 21 Feb 2027, covering up to 1.08 billion GRAM. The announced amount equals 37.84% of the circulating supply.

Inactive early miner wallets holding these tokens can become active when their suspension ends. This creates a large potential supply overhang, since a substantial amount of GRAM held in suspended wallets becomes available for use.
